apps.localizedDescription:
Reverse Panels is a native iPhone and iPad comic reader for your own library.

• Panel Flow: guided panel-by-panel reading, left-to-right or right-to-left, with an on-device panel detector
• Kavita, OPDS, Nextcloud, iCloud Drive, and on-device files
• CBZ, CBR, and PDF
• Offline downloads, Continue Reading, and Favorites
• No accounts, analytics, or tracking

This is a public beta. Please report bugs at github.com/josh-eg112/reverse-panels.
